payload.text: Aurora: Self-driving. Game-changing. Freight Safety Company Newsroom Careers Schedule a call Schedule a call Aurora is on a mission to improve road safety, increase supply chain efficiency, and reduce shipping costs through self-driving freight technology. Built with cutting-edge hardware and powerful software backed by verifiable AI, the Aurora Driver integrates the benefits of autonomy into your fleet. The second generation of the Aurora Driver is hauling customer freight today - with nobody behind the wheel. The next generation of self-driving freight. Our most capable platform yet, Aurora Driver 2 is powered by next-generation hardware built for million-mile durability and 24/7 fleet utilization. Add Aurora Driver to your fleet. Meet the Aurora Driver. Our intelligent self-driving system. Designed to integrate directly into your existing freight operations and operate trucks nearly round-the-clock, the Aurora Driver can reliably deliver your loads on time. Launch the truck to haul a load with us. Side Pods Center Pod Onboard Computer Planning Detecting and responding to the unexpected Planning Navigating erratic driving behavior, calmly and safely Planning Recognizing and respecting every vehicle on the road “Aurora’s transparent, safety-focused approach to delivering autonomous technology has always given me confidence they’re doing this the right way. Transforming an old school industry like trucking is never easy, but we can’t ignore the safety and efficiency benefits this technology can deliver. Autonomous trucks aren’t just going to help grow our business — they’re also going to give our drivers better lives by handling the lengthier and less desirable routes.” Richard Stocking President and CEO - Hirschbach Motor Lines “The early results of our pilot program with Aurora are impressive, particularly its ability to autonomously haul freight between Fort Worth and El Paso. The hybrid model of Werner professional drivers and the Aurora Driver will bring exemplary service to our customers while we continue to enhance the critical and long-haul routes that they demand.” Derek Leathers Chairman, President and CEO - Werner Enterprises “Freight volumes are projected to grow five fold between 2010-2050 making autonomous transport not just an innovation, but a necessity. This transformation is no small task and requires significant collaboration, which is why we have partnered with Aurora, whose Aurora Driver is seamlessly integrated into the Volvo VNL Autonomous.” Lars Stenqvist Executive Vice President, Group Trucks Technology and Volvo Group Chief Technology Officer “Do I feel safe with this technology around my family? Without hesitation, the answer is yes. We still have work to do educating the public. It’s extremely safe, vetted, and checked over and over.” Thomas Mrozinski Former Commercial Vehicle Enforcement - Frisco Police Department “Seeing what the truck is seeing is just insane. Humans can’t see this far. We can’t see this many angle…
